verdict.rationale: Reader offers opt-in semantic chunking of its markdown output into a JSON array of chunks (x-markdown-chunking) and a token cap (x-max-tokens), and it accepts Excel files via POST. Together these can split large content to fit processing limits. Nothing in the evidence shows the chunking is table-aware, such as keeping rows intact or repeating headers per chunk, and x-max-tokens trims content rather than splitting it. missing for 10: table-aware chunking that preserves row/header structure, documentation or examples of very large table extraction, independent or hands-on corroboration of chunking quality on tables.
